records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets and zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:cac353c4, email:417bf698). Internal handoff note (slack:0b1c6b93) suggests no owner engagement. No signal of intent, so unaided activation in 8 days is unlikely though not impossible on an active Pro plan.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

I wanted to check in now that your Wrenfield workspace has been open a week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week -- just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
